bonuses.name: Iron Soul
bonuses.text: This Follower is unaffected by abilities that target the mind, and never needs to make a Resolve test to continue fighting.

options.name: Augur Skull
options.text: The Skull’s Awareness is increased to 8 (Passive 4), and it is fitted with Preysense Goggles and an Auspex.

options.name: Auto-Scribe Skull
options.text: The Skull has a Scholar skill of 6. It grants the owner +2d on all Investigate and Scholar tests.

options.name: Combat Skull
options.text: The Skull has a Weapon Skill of 6. It gains a Mono-Blade: 7 +2 ED / AP -1 / Rending (1)

options.name: Courier
options.text: The Skull is fitted with an identity scanner and various recording and playback devices. It is programmed to seek out a recipient and deliver messages to them.

options.name: Gheistskull
options.text: Commonly used by the Imperial Navy, a Gheistskull contains a Vox Disruptor Array, and an explosive charge (Frag Grenade). The owner may make Tech Interaction Attacks through the Skull. The explosive charge can be detonated at any time the owner wishes, as a Simple Action, destroying the Skull.

options.name: Gun Skull
options.text: The Skull has a Ballistic Skill of 6. It gains a Laspistol: 7 +1 ED / Range 6-12-18 / Salvo 1 / Reliable. This may be replaced with any other Pistol.

options.name: Illuminator
options.text: The Skull is fitted with a powerful light source—a lamp-pack, glow-globe, or brazier of coals.

options.name: Laud Hauler
options.text: The Skull is fitted with a powerful vox-grille, and may replay recorded messages or sounds, or its owner may speak through it over a vox system. Any ability the owner has which uses their voice may determine range from the Skull instead of themselves.

options.name: Medicae Skull
options.text: The Skull is fitted with a Medikit and has a Medicae skill of 6.

options.name: Utility Skull
options.text: The Skull has a combi-tool and a Tech skill of 6. It may assist its owner by adding +2d to Tech tests attempted while it is within 10m.
